bash -c "
set -e

echo '[pipeline] Starting auto CRM pipeline monitor at $(date)'
echo '[pipeline] Will poll precompute progress every 5 min, then auto-execute merge + training'

# === PHASE 1: Wait for all precompute to finish ===
echo '[pipeline] Phase 1: Monitoring precompute completion...'

while true; do
    # Check bjb1-32546 (Object s1-s9)
    OBJ_PROCS=\$(ssh bjb1-32546 'ps aux | grep train_crm | grep precompute | grep -v grep | wc -l' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    # Check bjb2-40593 (Object s0)  
    OBJ0_PROCS=\$(ssh bjb2-40593 'ps aux | grep train_crm | grep precompute | grep -v grep | wc -l' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    # Check bjb2-28827 (Spatial s0-s5)
    SPA_PROCS=\$(ssh bjb2-28827 'ps aux | grep train_crm | grep precompute | grep -v grep | wc -l' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    # Check local (Spatial s6)
    SPA6_PROCS=\$(ps aux | grep train_crm | grep precompute | grep -v grep | wc -l)
    
    TOTAL=\$((OBJ_PROCS + OBJ0_PROCS + SPA_PROCS + SPA6_PROCS))
    echo \"[pipeline] \$(date): precompute processes remaining: bjb1-32546=\${OBJ_PROCS} bjb2-40593=\${OBJ0_PROCS} bjb2-28827=\${SPA_PROCS} local=\${SPA6_PROCS} total=\${TOTAL}\"
    
    if [ \"\$TOTAL\" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo '[pipeline] All precompute processes finished!'
        break
    fi
    
    sleep 300
done

# === PHASE 2: Clean old partials on bjb1-18228 ===
echo '[pipeline] Phase 2: Cleaning old object partials on bjb1-18228...'
rm -f /root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_pi05/object/partial_s*.pt
rm -f /root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_pi05/object/obs_features.pt /root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_pi05/object/k_samples.pt /root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_pi05/object/expert_actions.pt /root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_pi05/object/manifest.json
echo '[pipeline] Old partials cleaned'

# === PHASE 3: rsync all shard caches to bjb1-18228 ===
echo '[pipeline] Phase 3: Rsyncing all shard caches...'

# Object shard 0 from bjb2-40593
echo '[pipeline] rsync Object s0 from bjb2-40593...'
rsync -av bjb2-40593:/root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_pi05/object/partial_s0_*.pt /root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_pi05/object/
echo '[pipeline] Object s0 done'

# Object shards 1-9 from bjb1-32546
echo '[pipeline] rsync Object s1-9 from bjb1-32546...'
rsync -av bjb1-32546:/root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_pi05/object/partial_s*.pt /root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_pi05/object/
echo '[pipeline] Object s1-9 done'

# Spatial shards 0-5 from bjb2-28827
echo '[pipeline] rsync Spatial s0-5 from bjb2-28827...'
rsync -av bjb2-28827:/root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_pi05/spatial/partial_s*.pt /root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_pi05/spatial/
echo '[pipeline] Spatial s0-5 done'
# Spatial s6 already local

echo '[pipeline] rsync complete. File counts:'
ls /root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_pi05/object/partial_s*.pt 2>/dev/null | wc -l
ls /root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_pi05/spatial/partial_s*.pt 2>/dev/null | wc -l

# === PHASE 4: Merge ===
echo '[pipeline] Phase 4: Merge...'
cd /root/acr-vla-conformal-refinement
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

# Dry-run first
echo '[pipeline] Object merge dry-run...'
python scripts/merge_precompute_cache.py --cache_dir /root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_pi05/object --num_shards 10 --dry_run

echo '[pipeline] Spatial merge dry-run...'
python scripts/merge_precompute_cache.py --cache_dir /root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_pi05/spatial --num_shards 7 --dry_run

# Actual merge
echo '[pipeline] Object merge...'
python scripts/merge_precompute_cache.py --cache_dir /root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_pi05/object --num_shards 10

echo '[pipeline] Spatial merge...'
python scripts/merge_precompute_cache.py --cache_dir /root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_pi05/spatial --num_shards 7

# Verify merge output
echo '[pipeline] Merge verification:'
ls -la /root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_pi05/object/{obs_features.pt,k_samples.pt,expert_actions.pt,manifest.json}
ls -la /root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_pi05/spatial/{obs_features.pt,k_samples.pt,expert_actions.pt,manifest.json}
python -c \"import torch; o=torch.load('/root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_pi05/object/obs_features.pt',weights_only=True); print('Object obs:', o.shape)\"
python -c \"import torch; s=torch.load('/root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_pi05/spatial/obs_features.pt',weights_only=True); print('Spatial obs:', s.shape)\"

echo '[pipeline] Phase 4 complete!'
echo '[pipeline] CRM training will be started by separate jobs on cuda:0 and cuda:1'
echo '[pipeline] DONE at $(date)'
"
